segments.sn47.5:1.3: “‘akusalarāsī’ti, bhikkhave, vadamāno pañca nīvaraṇe sammā vadamāno vadeyya.
segments.sn47.5:1.4: Kevalo hāyaṃ, bhikkhave, akusalarāsi, yadidaṃ – pañca nīvaraṇā.
segments.sn47.5:1.7: ‘Akusalarāsī’ti, bhikkhave, vadamāno ime pañca nīvaraṇe sammā vadamāno vadeyya.
segments.sn47.5:1.8: Kevalo hāyaṃ, bhikkhave, akusalarāsi, yadidaṃ – pañca nīvaraṇā.
segments.sn47.5:2.1: “‘Kusalarāsī’ti, bhikkhave, vadamāno cattāro satipaṭṭhāne sammā vadamāno vadeyya.
segments.sn47.5:2.2: Kevalo hāyaṃ, bhikkhave, kusalarāsi, yadidaṃ – cattāro satipaṭṭhānā.
segments.sn47.5:2.4: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ;
segments.sn47.5:2.5: vedanāsu … pe … citte … pe … dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
segments.sn47.5:2.8: ‘Kusalarāsī’ti, bhikkhave, vadamāno ime cattāro satipaṭṭhāne sammā vadamāno vadeyya.
segments.sn47.5:2.9: Kevalo hāyaṃ, bhikkhave, kusalarāsi, yadidaṃ – cattāro satipaṭṭhānā”ti.

lines: Pañcame kevaloti kusaladhammehi asammisso, tato eva sakalo sukkapakkho anavajjaṭṭho.
